- Per u16 char: 0x0A=newline (x back to start, y += StyleData_GetFontLineHeight*scale); 0x20=advance StyleData_GetFontSpaceWidth*scale; 0x23 '#' = toggle palette (caller pal/remap <-> PALETTE_BASE_FONT_REMAP(8)/remap 0), draws nothing; everything else = glyph.
- Glyph (non-kanji fonts): fontSpriteId = fontBases[fontId] + (ch - 0x21) (StyleData_GetFontGlyphSpriteId); sprite type 7 (FONT); NO bounds clamp (ch<0x21 or ch>0x21+count-1 reads neighbouring font's sprites). advance = sprite w * scale (no kerning).
- fontId == g_FontRole_Kanji16 / g_FontRole_Kanji32: glyph comes from KanjiFont (kanji.dat) bitmap uploaded to a texture per char (KanjiFont_UploadGlyphSmall/Large); '#' there switches KanjiFont colours.
- invisibility (arg8) -> Text_GetQuadFlags (0 visible, 1, 2 blend modes); alpha (arg9, byte) = (alpha<<27)|0xFFFFFF vertex colour for modes 1/2. |0x20000 always; |0x10000 when scale==1.0.
